metaTitle: Custom Koozie Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Koozie badge ID holders for your team. Durable, clear vinyl pouches with lanyards. Perfect for events and daily use.
introHtml: Koozie badge ID holders combine the durability of clear vinyl with the reliability of a trusted supplier. These holders keep IDs visible and secure with options like bulldog clips, hang holes, or lanyards. Ideal for tradeshows, offices, and safety environments where quick identification matters. Choose from sizes like 3" x 5" or 4" x 6" to fit standard badges, and add your logo for consistent branding across your team.
heroAltText: Custom Koozie badge ID holders with clear vinyl pouch and lanyard for employee identification
